### Our MISSION

## Our MISSION

With a commitment to excellence unparalleled in the industry, Prestige Group is dedicated to providing superior individually focused, professional service to help our clients reach their commercial real estate goals.

We maintain the highest ethical and professional standards and are driven to be highly knowledgeable

and experienced real estate professionals.

Our goal is to respond to our clients’ needs and build long term, trust-based client relationships.

### OUR HISTORY

## OUR HISTORY

The Prestige Group was founded by Richard Natow in 1987. Through ingenuity, creativity, education and entrepreneurial thinking, Prestige Group has flourished!

An independently owned and operated company, Prestige Group has the flexibility to adapt to meet

the needs of the ever-changing market.

The focus of our business has evolved from our roots in land sales to full service commercial real estate brokerage.

Our areas of specialization have been carefully chosen. As a “Boutique” brokerage organization, we are certain of our abilities to be successful as well as confident about our continued growth in these asset types.

Our record has been overwhelming! Prestige Group has been the recipient of many major industry awards as well as having been twice honored by The Philadelphia Business Journal as one of the “Philadelphia Top 100”. Due to outstanding sales, The Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania twice chose Prestige Group as one of the fastest-growing private firms in the Philadelphia region.

We strive for the highest levels of professionalism, ethics, and service to our clients to continue our success.

### OUR TEAM

## OUR TEAM

With an entrepreneurial attitude, a commitment to excellence, teamwork, integrity, continued education and creativity we specialize in all facets of commercial real estate, land sales and new home marketing.
